properties.statement:
THE SCHEMA-DISCOVERY TAX, TALLIED BY A USER FOR ONE SESSION: ~24 rejected calls across 11+ tools (dev_storyflow, 2026-09-05), every one 'for a reason the tool already knew and could have shown up front', and 'none taught me anything about the design; all taught me the shape of a struct.' The reporter also REPRODUCED the add_change_event four-step ladder (description -> affected struct -> change_type enum -> subject enum) 'exactly, on a new day, by a caller who had read that entry' — direct evidence for chg:three-additive-surface-fixes-from-field-feedback's premise that a tool description is not read mid-work.

ROOT CAUSE, READ FROM THE CODE: every enum-valued constructor field is typed `Option<String>` on its Req struct (service.rs: category, direction, method, level, subject, change_type ...). The JsonSchema derive therefore publishes `string`, and the legal set lives only in the handler / the shared enum helper — so the SCHEMA, which is what a harness shows an agent before the first call, cannot know the values. Validation is in the code path, not in the type. That is the class; each field is an instance.

WHAT IS ALREADY BUILT AND WORKING: req:a-refusal-names-what-would-have-worked / chg:a-refusal-names-what-would-have-worked — a REFUSED enum names its legal values, in one shared helper. The reporter confirms it. So the tax is now ONE round-trip per enum field, not a guessing game. WHAT IS NOT BUILT: wish #20 — the values in the schema BEFORE the first call, so the first call can be correct. dec:idea-should-a-refusal-teach-every-rule-it-knows-in-one-reply already holds this question, open.

THE OTHER HALF OF THE TAX IS NOT ENUMS: shape inconsistency across siblings — get_node needs node_type though the id prefix names it; depends_on takes from_id/to_id while governed_by takes from_type/from_id/to_type/to_id; add_decision rejects status while add_capability accepts it; add_verification lacks the distinct_from override add_decision has; record_change and add_change_event are different shapes for the same act. That half is fact:defect-sibling-constructors-disagree-on-how-to-name-a-node-and-what-status-it-lands-in and fact:defect-typed-tool-parameter-names-are-inconsistent (recorded twice before), and this session adds the RELATION tools to it.

THE FIX CLASS for the enum half: declare the enum in the TYPE (a Rust enum, or a schemars enum annotation on the field) so the published schema carries `enum: [...]` and the refusal helper reads the same list. One mechanism, every field gains it. Not built; needs scoping across ~15 fields. NOT MEASURED: how many harnesses actually surface the JSON schema's enum list to the agent before a call — if few do, the schema fix buys less than the refusal fix already did.
